front.title: AN ACT CONCERNING CENTRALIZATION OF WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT INFORMATION.

runs: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Assembly convened:

Section 1. (NEW) (Effective October 1, 2026) Not later than January 1, 2027, the Labor Commissioner shall create an informational web page, as part of the Internet web site of the Labor Department, to serve as a central repository of information, resources and materials, including links to external sources of such information, resources and materials regarding (1) job training, career counseling and workforce development organizations and opportunities available, (2) regional sector partnerships, and (3) other topics relevant to workforce development. The Labor Commissioner shall, on a semiannual basis, update the information, resources and materials described in this section for items to be included on such informational web page.
